entries.text: You're certainly worthy. Here, I want you to have this.
entries.zh: 你确实有这个资格。来，这件东西就交给你了。

entries.raw: §fThat §rBeastslayer's Codex §fincreases its §aStats §fand §dRarity §fas you reach more §3Bestiary Milestones§f.
entries.text: That Beastslayer's Codex increases its Stats and Rarity as you reach more Bestiary Milestones.
entries.zh: 这本猎兽者法典会随着你达成更多生物图鉴里程碑，而提升其属性与稀有度。

entries.raw: §fIt has served me throughout my travels, but those days are now long behind me.
entries.text: It has served me throughout my travels, but those days are now long behind me.
entries.zh: 它陪我走过了许多地方。不过，那些四处闯荡的日子，早就过去啦。
